title: Ponosakan language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sulawesi, Indonesia
extract: Ponosakan is a moribund Austronesian language spoken in the vicinity of the district of Belang, Southeast Minahasa, North Sulawesi, Indonesia. This language is almost extinct, with only four fluent speakers left as of November 2014.
